interpretation.primary_macro: Classical routing on quantum readout improves three of four Macro point estimates and worsens one; effects differ by feature and selector.
interpretation.secondary_CE: All four classical-routing/quantum-readout composites worsen CE relative to quantum diagonal, while all four classical diagonals have better CE and Macro.
interpretation.supported: The diagonal classical advantage is not a readout-independent joint advantage across the declared Macro and CE endpoints for these frozen models.
interpretation.not_identified: No isolated quantum-circuit effect, population causal mediation, training-gain attribution or inherent routing inferiority/superiority.
interpretation.interaction: All four score cross-differences are positive. These are descriptive nonlinear metric contrasts, not proof of a novel algebraic interaction law or unique coadaptation cause.

limits: One initialization, four frozen development epochs and972 examples from original train prefix; no official valid/test.
Evaluation misses17,23,24,32,36,37; fixed positive39 Macro preserved, no class/metric/seed/epoch rescue.
Routing includes learned preparation and interaction; complete readout is swapped together. No decoder-latent basis split.
Parameter-count matching is not compute/function-class matching. Direct interchange can expose compatibility effects.
No inferential intervals or significance claims; all18 cells and both declared endpoints retained.
